description: This is a test class for the ConfigDao component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for the ConfigDao methods, such as setting and getting configuration values, and uses fixtures to verify database interactions.

classes.name: ConfigDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ConfigDao functionalities, including setting and retrieving configuration values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a ConfigDao instance and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testSetValue
methods.description: Verifies that the setValue method correctly sets new and existing configuration values.

methods.name: testGetValue
methods.description: Checks that getValue retrieves the correct configuration value from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAllValues
methods.description: Ensures that getAllValues returns all configuration key-value pairs correctly.

methods.name: _isValueSet
methods.description: Private helper method to verify if a specific configuration key has a particular value in the database.
